# Title that pops in

- Kind: `recipe`
- Category: `vector`
- Slug: `vector/text-pop`

## Summary

Motion recipe (basic). A pop scales from 0 to about 110 % and settles at 100 % (overshoot), with opacity reaching 1 in the first third.

## Details

### When to use
A headline or word that should arrive with energy.
### What a pro does and why
A pop scales from 0 to about 110 % and settles at 100 % (overshoot), with opacity reaching 1 in the first third. 0.35 to 0.5 s total; anything longer feels slow.
### Ops
```json
{
  "summary": "Text pop",
  "ops": [
    {"op": "animate", "layerId": "LAYER_ID", "property": "transform.scaleX", "keyframes": [{"t": 0, "value": 0, "easing": "easeOut"}, {"t": 280, "value": 1.1, "easing": "easeBoth"}, {"t": 420, "value": 1, "easing": "linear"}]},
    {"op": "animate", "layerId": "LAYER_ID", "property": "transform.scaleY", "keyframes": [{"t": 0, "value": 0, "easing": "easeOut"}, {"t": 280, "value": 1.1, "easing": "easeBoth"}, {"t": 420, "value": 1, "easing": "linear"}]},
    {"op": "animate", "layerId": "LAYER_ID", "property": "opacity", "keyframes": [{"t": 0, "value": 0, "easing": "linear"}, {"t": 140, "value": 1, "easing": "linear"}]}
  ]
}
```
Set the text anchor to its centre first so it scales from the middle. Shortcut: `{"op":"template","kind":"titlePop","text":"Big news"}`.
### How to adjust
Less bounce: peak 1.04. Calmer: use only the opacity track with a 20 px rise on `transform.y`.
